grid.layout_notes: Sheet branding 6x5. Includes top reel / bottom reel structure for Wild Transform and xNudge on bottom reel; some positions locked in main game and unlock in bonus.

win_system.notes: xWays / Infectious xWays expand ways. Exact base ways count not printed on sheet. Grit Girl is a scatter-paying symbol (pays on 3+ reels).

cascades_or_tumbles.how_it_works: Reel Split doubles symbols above it on the main reel, then vanishes causing a bottom-reel collapse for new symbols.

expanding_reels.how_it_works: Torture Spins / Dead Spins expand the active game area and unlock previously locked main-game positions for the bonus.

other.name: Wild Transform
other.how_it_works: Match symbol in top reel with symbol underneath on same reel → both become Wild.

other.name: xNudge Wild
other.how_it_works: Stacked Wild on bottom reel always nudges fully visible; +1 wild multiplier per nudge. Second chance with higher multiplier if first nudge does not win.

other.name: xWays & Infectious xWays
other.how_it_works: xWays reveals 2–3 of the same symbol. Infectious xWays multiplies all symbols of the revealed type.

other.name: Transform 'em
other.how_it_works: Transforms all of the same symbol type into the same symbol (all character symbols become the same one).

wilds.name: xNudge Wild
wilds.behavior: Stacked Wild on bottom reel; nudges fully into view; +1 multiplier per nudge; second-chance nudge with higher multiplier if no win first time.

wilds.name: Wild (transform / sticky)
wilds.behavior: Created by Wild Transform (top+under match). Dead Spins unlock sticky Wild with multiplier in bottom-right corner for the bonus duration.

scatters.name: Scatter
scatters.behavior: 3 Scatters → 8+ Torture Spins. 4 Scatters → 10+ Dead Spins.

scatters.name: Grit Girl
scatters.behavior: Scatter-paying symbol: pays when appearing on 3+ reels. Base x25 on 3 reels, x500 on 4 reels, with chance of a massive multiplier.

specials.name: Infectious xWays
specials.behavior: Affects and multiplies all symbols of the revealed type.

specials.name: Reel Split
specials.behavior: Doubles all symbols above it on the main reel, then vanishes and collapses the bottom reel for new symbols.

base_game_loop.summary: Paid spin on 6×5-style grid with locked positions. Wild Transform, xNudge bottom Wild, xWays/Infectious xWays, Reel Split collapses, and Transform 'em can reshape the grid before ways pay. Grit Girl pays as scatter on 3+/4 reels. 3 Scatters → Torture Spins (8+); 4 → Dead Spins (10+). Buy 69×–669×.

phases.name: Spin
phases.what_happens: Reels stop including top/bottom reel structure; some positions may be locked.

phases.name: Modifiers
phases.what_happens: Apply Wild Transform, xNudge (with possible second chance), xWays / Infectious xWays, Reel Split collapse, Transform 'em as they land.

phases.name: Evaluate wins
phases.what_happens: Pay ways wins and Grit Girl scatter pays (3+ / 4 reels).

phases.name: Bonus check
phases.what_happens: 3 Scatters → 8+ Torture Spins (expand area, unlock locked positions). 4 Scatters → 10+ Dead Spins (expand + unlock including sticky Wild with multiplier bottom-right).

base_game_loop.win_evaluation: After nudge/transform/split modifiers; Grit Girl pays independently as scatter-style on reel counts.
base_game_loop.notes: Exact meaning of '8+' / '10+' extra spin awards beyond base 8/10 not detailed on sheet.

modes.name: Torture Spins
modes.sticky_or_persistent_state: Active game area expands; locked positions from main game available for the bonus duration.
modes.end_condition: Spins complete or No More Grit max win 20,220×.

phases.name: Enter Torture
phases.what_happens: Expand active area; unlock main-game locked positions; play 8+ spins.

modes.effects: 8+ FS with expanded area and unlocked positions.

modes.name: Dead Spins
modes.sticky_or_persistent_state: Expanded area; all previously locked spots available including sticky Wild with multiplier in bottom-right corner for the bonus duration.

phases.name: Enter Dead Spins
phases.what_happens: Expand area; unlock all locked spots including bottom-right sticky Wild+multiplier; play 10+ spins.

modes.effects: 10+ FS; full unlock including sticky Wild with multiplier bottom-right.

## Wild Transform
Match the symbol in the top reel and the symbol underneath on the same reel to transform both into a Wild symbol.

## xNudge Wild
Stacked Wild symbol in the bottom reel that will always nudge to be fully visible, each nudge increased a wild multiplier by 1. Get a 2nd chance with an even higher multiplier if you don’t win on it the first time...

## xWays & Infectious xWays
You’ve seen it before - xWays reveals 2-3 of the same symbol. Infectious xWays symbol will affect and multiply all symbols of the revealed type for massive wins.

## Reel Split
Reel split will double all symbols above it on the main reel. It then vanishes, causing a bottom reel collapse for new symbols to appear.

## Transform ‘em
Will transform all of the same symbol type into the same symbol, meaning that all character symbols will turn into the same one!

## Grit Girl
Scatter paying symbol that pays as soon as she appears on 3+ reels. Grit Girl has the base payout of x25, four reels have a base payout of x500, but it will also have the chance of a massive multiplier....
